text: Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it): 1 if at least one comment explicitly quantifies systemic (institutional, structural or society-wide, not merely isolated) material harm to third parties (people other than the commenter), e.g. deaths, money, jobs, health, housing, resources lost, by giving numbers, rates, amounts, proportions or explicit magnitudes. Does not count: vague harm claims without a quantity, purely abstract/moral/propositional arguments, harms only to the commenter or hypothetical individuals. Quoted material counts only if the commenter adopts it. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is neither positive evidence nor outcome reporting. List order is irrelevant. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
